question: Which company recently became the first private-sector fintech to gain membership in the Reserve Bank of India's Centralised Payment System (CPS)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pay Point India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Pay Point India Network** has achieved a major breakthrough by becoming the first private-sector fintech to gain membership in the **Centralised Payment System (CPS)** operated by the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**
